pr_body:
This PR introduces the `auto_translate` variable, which tell `Control` and `Window` nodes if they should update their texts accordingly with the current locale.

I've also made so that window titles also update with translation changes.

Fixes #43151.
Supersedes #43159.
pr_comments:
See also godotengine/godot-proposals#2783.

This PR is fine for me too, but I think we need to remove `set_message_translation` and `can_translate_messages` so that `tr` always behaves the same regardless of the object (we can move it to `@GDScript` or `@GlobalScope`).

Some controls (for example`OptionButton`) are missing. Will they be fixed in another PR?

> This PR is fine for me too, but I think we need to remove `set_message_translation` and `can_translate_messages` so that `tr` always behaves the same regardless of the object (we can move it to `@GDScript` or `@GlobalScope`).

As discussed in both the dev chat and in your proposal, the plan is to leave `set_message_translation()` alone in favor of this new variable.

> Some controls (for example `OptionButton`) are missing. Will they be fixed in another PR?

For now, if you want the setting to also affect internal popup of buttons, you need to do it manually via `$OptionButton.get_popup().auto_translate`. I could definitely do another PR making certain nodes do more stuff with this setting on their own sometime later once this is merged.

Perhaps I was not quite accurate, but the main idea is that changing the `tr` behavior for an object is bad, because a script can be attached to it. The new property does not change the behavior of `tr`, so there is no need for these two methods.
Instead of adding `is_auto_translating()` everywhere, wouldn't it be better to add a helper method to Control that does it automatically? Could be even inline.

No I mean, let's say the method is called `tr2`, so instead of `is_auto_translating() ? tr(p_string) : p_string` you'd just do `tr2(p_string)` and the `tr2()` would be `tr2(p_string) { return is_auto_translating() ? tr(p_string) : p_string;)`

It would simplify the code.
Ooh! Yes, that could be done.
@KoBeWi Done! Settled with `atr()` for the method's name.

**Issue description:**

var label = Label.new()
label.text = "WORD"

if the WORD is a key in translations used somewhere else, the label will display a translated text.
This is not intented. If the translated text required, we can use tr("WORD").
However, if the "WORD" is input from the user, it's weird to displayed a translated text.



**Steps to reproduce:**

comments:
This behavior is intended (https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/i18n/internationalizing_games.html#converting-keys-to-text), because if the developer decides later to localize the game, there won't be any need to change code everywhere to enable that.

However, there is no way to disable this behavior, and as you pointed out, there are good cases where this needs to be disabled.

review_comments: Maybe this should go in the main groupless properties instead of a dedicated group with a single property?
Or not, as `Control` doesn't have such groupless properties so this would be awkward.
